analysis: RQ2 within-class accuracy and class-composition-adjusted whole-test versus tail gaps

definitions.within_class_eligible_class: true class with at least one tail and one non-tail test node in that run
definitions.class_adjusted_tail_class: true class with at least one tail test node in that run
definitions.within_class_accuracy_contrast: unweighted mean over eligible true classes of non-tail accuracy minus tail accuracy
definitions.within_class_positive_contrast: tail accuracy is lower within the average eligible class
definitions.reference_class_distribution: whole-test true-class proportions renormalised over tail-present classes
definitions.tail_conditional_confusion_rows: tail prediction-label distribution within each tail-present true class
definitions.class_reweighted_tail_confusion: tail conditional confusion rows multiplied by the whole-test reference class proportions
definitions.whole_test_score: ordinary score over whole-test nodes whose true class is present in the tail
definitions.excluded_true_classes: classes absent from the tail are outside both evaluated populations
definitions.predictions_outside_tail_classes: retained as false negatives for tail-present true classes
definitions.class_adjusted_contrast: whole-test score minus class-reweighted tail score
definitions.class_adjusted_positive_contrast: tail performance is lower after class-composition adjustment
definitions.cell_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the 30 run-level contrasts

common.method: two-sided percentile bootstrap of complete runs

bootstrap_intervals.within_class_accuracy_seed_derivation: SHA256(global seed, dataset, model, preparation, class-macro-accuracy), matching the original RQ2 table
bootstrap_intervals.class_adjusted_seed_derivation: SHA256(global seed, dataset, model, erm-tail-gap), matching RQ1

definitions.rq2_condition: ERM macro-F1 tail-gap mean is positive and its 95% paired-bootstrap interval lies wholly above zero

inputs.raw_store: config.json and run_data.npz from the external run store, validated against manifests/main-runs.jsonl and the dataset manifests
